goal: Keep one full-capability topology while avoiding meaningless optimization through downstream modules whose causal owners are not yet active.
procedure: Precommit active macro families and trainable owners per stage. Leave the full topology instantiated. Do not compute inactive downstream families. Activate a family only when all modules necessary to make its loss causally meaningful can co-adapt.
constraints: all ten families active in J3 before final selection
decision_criteria: inactive random arbiters cannot shape upstream gradients
newly activated family owners train together
authority: Optimization architecture only; no GPU/gradient/final authorization.
validation: Exact-head static suite later passed with stage-family ownership proofs.
failure_or_lesson: A full architecture does not require every random downstream loss to be active from step one. Capability preservation comes from one topology and eventual joint co-adaptation, not from routing nonsense gradients through untrained arbiters.

goal: Ensure J1 long query/relation/factor supervision is owned by the semantic-operator task rather than borrowed from behavioral rows that intentionally lack semantic token-evidence authority.
procedure: Audit row keys and objective ownership. Add a dedicated public TRAIN/DEV semantic-operator long-context supplement. Preserve relation program, factors, events, uncertainty and exact evidence char spans while moving decisive text beyond the native-window operating point. Bind that lane separately in scheduling and the public-mixture manifest.
constraints: operating point is not a product context ceiling
decision_criteria: rows compile through registered semantic_operator task
J1 scheduler rejects behavioral long rows as semantic authority
authority: Public N0 training coverage only; no external-compute authorization.
validation: Exact-head CI at ac0def passed 174 tests with the dedicated semantic-long static audit registered.
failure_or_lesson: Surface similarity is not target ownership. A curriculum example belongs to a training lane only when its labels and compiler match the causal capability that lane is supposed to teach.

goal: Prevent training or qualification orchestration from silently dropping a capability lane or substituting an easier fixture.
procedure: Hash-bind each optimizer-facing lane separately. Preserve real teacher contrastive prerequisites in dry-run fixtures. Require GPU no-gradient qualification to cover both maximum-runtime-axis semantics and dedicated long-context semantics on the same registered topology.
constraints: no FINAL rows in training/model selection
decision_criteria: dry run executes real objective paths
long and high-cardinality semantic cases both covered
authority: No-gradient preparation only; optimizer and gradient remain unauthorized.
validation: Exact-head CI passed; external CPU/GPU receipts remain unresolved blocking evidence.
failure_or_lesson: A smoke test can be structurally misleading even when it uses the right model class. Qualification must exercise the real lanes and objective prerequisites the trainer will consume.
